description: This file defines a template class 'BaseCategoryType' within the 'WPEFramework::Messaging' namespace, which manages message category data with support for formatted text and length retrieval. It also includes a macro to define derived category classes with specific characteristics.

classes.name: BaseCategoryType
classes.description: A template class representing a message category with a specific metadata type, supporting text formatting, data retrieval, and length measurement.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the internal text data as a C-style string.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the internal text data.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the internal text data to the provided string.
